cues.what: the camera pushes into the first corner

cues.f: round(0.4 * fps) + round(max(12, min(28, (frames / fps - 1.6) * 30 / 2 - 22)) * fps / 30) + round(3 * fps / 30)

cues.what: the camera pulls back and pushes into the other corner

cues.f: round(frames / 2 + 0.4 * fps) + round(max(12, min(28, (frames / fps - 1.6) * 30 / 2 - 22)) * fps / 30) + round(3 * fps / 30)
